summary: A statewide limit on property tax growth takes effect and towns cut staff, with schools taking a large share of the cuts.
realLife: After Massachusetts voters approved the 2.5 percent levy cap in 1980, districts such as Brockton and Quincy laid off hundreds of teachers or cut millions from municipal budgets in the early years. Towns can exceed the cap only with a voter-approved override, and in 2026 some towns still held override votes to keep police, schools and firefighters.
sources: Education Week, effects of Proposition 2 1/2 on Massachusetts budgets, Jun 1983: https://www.edweek.org/education/effects-of-proposition-2-1-2-squeez-mass-budgets/1983/06
